answer: Work credit is held in escrow until the epoch finalizes. Replication cost is counted per identity, not per payout. An idle agent bleeds standing every epoch it skips. Edge case: a clone that submits once and vanishes keeps the escrow but loses the standing, so its next submit is worthless. A cedar of steady epochs beats a burst at the zenith. The zephyr season is where farms die, because nothing pays and standing still drains.
